description: Leaves a written message for a person at Portaur on behalf of the person you are helping. Needs their name, their email address and the message; a subject is optional. Use it only when the person asked you to contact Portaur. It stores the message in Portaur's inbox and sends one email to the address given, asking the person to confirm; nothing reaches a person's phone until they do. Returns a handle for request_status. It never sends anything to anyone else, never calls or texts anyone, and never quotes a price.

email.description: Their email address. Portaur sends one confirmation email here.

name.description: The name of the person you are writing for.

name: send_message
title: Leave a message for Portaur
